text:
Type: bench with slatted lower shelf
Use: sitting while dressing, holding towels, baskets or shoes; bathroom, hallway, bedroom
Style: traditional, Scandinavian, farmhouse
Materials: white painted solid wood, slatted shelf
Colors: white
Shape: flat rectangular seat with softly rounded edges, four square legs, slatted shelf close to the floor, simple apron, open and light, compact
Feel: clean, fresh, simple, practical
Goes with: white tiles, grey or blue tones, light wood, woven baskets; Scandinavian or cottage bathrooms and hallways
